participant_disposition.reason: This repo's G1 replica run shows scan-adoption completeness beside a structured init --apply refusal and a blocked doctor; that polarity split is real enough to pilot, not enough to change shared G1 scoring from one owner.

minimum_decision_record.problem: G1 prove_active_resolution was scored pass from scan-adoption completeness=complete with zero diagnostics on replica pos-4 at b313becf, while the same run's init --apply exited 2 with applied=false and doctor reported 0 healthy/degraded plus 1 blocked/degraded. Missing-target init --repo /this/path/does/not/exist also exited 0 with a create-plan JSON after traversal correctly fail-closed. Scanner snapshots can therefore stand in for an active owner resolution.
minimum_decision_record.audience_and_scope: Heterogeneous SoftwareCo monorepos that already pin policy/engineering-lane.json (this repo: 8f59f4178f0c40f73d64c417e7a591de42a0f0d2, lane pi-ts). Non-goals: splitting the monorepo, promoting a G1 field from one owner, mutating engineering-core src/, claiming G1 or G4 PASS, or writing a content-owner decision.
minimum_decision_record.invariant_or_decision_rule: scan-adoption completeness is a diagnostic, not proof of an active v1 resolution. prove_active_resolution may pass only when the same revision's owner-apply either applies a declared resolution or is scored as a lawful structured refusal. Missing-target and traversal inputs must fail closed with no plan JSON. Repo-level green checks, complete scanner reports, and doctor exit 0 cannot substitute for that polarity.
minimum_decision_record.load_triggers: G1 or adoption scan of a brownfield consumer that already has policy/engineering-lane.json; a prove_active_resolution journey that would pass from completeness=complete alone; init/plan --repo against a missing path or a path containing ..; review of a G1 run with mixed journey status and g1_pass_claimed=false.
minimum_decision_record.evidence_references: docs/v1-proof/g1-run.json sha256 0f06c6cf63276204dacdebdb7d02f338bb666ab4c4f8e592865421b1966e2b43 (schema engineering-core.v1.g1-run/1, candidate b313becf7f1bf5261843d7b29c939b0bc5072ef1, g1_pass_claimed=false, counts pass=6 fail=1 incomplete=3). prove_active_resolution pass via scan-adoption completeness=complete. apply_owner_plan incomplete via init --apply exit 2 applied=false. diagnose_v1_adoption doctor static-only, 1 blocked/degraded. failure_boundaries fail: traversal exit 1, missing-dir init exit 0 create plan. Consumer pin policy/engineering-lane.json ref 8f59f4178f0c40f73d64c417e7a591de42a0f0d2. admission.md sha256 81b83462c9d5e99ba417f4571b1a084e310730b2fe46ce85a340cd19e77fda56.
minimum_decision_record.strongest_alternative: Keep prove_active_resolution defined as scanner completeness on the scope root. Rejected: this packet already refused G1 PASS while that journey passed. Treating every structured init --apply refusal as adoption failure is also rejected; a brownfield pin can be lawful local adoption truth.
minimum_decision_record.counterevidence_and_exceptions: A greenfield repo with no policy/engineering-lane.json may receive an init create plan. A single-package repo may not show the doctor-blocked/scanner-complete split. Doctor exit 0 is not a health claim. Live Pi install/reload proof is a different unit. One SoftwareCo monorepo is not two owner groups.
minimum_decision_record.falsification_conditions: A second distinct positive owner group observes scanner completeness and an applied owner resolution and a non-blocked doctor on the same revision; or missing-target init fail-closes and prove_active_resolution can no longer pass from scanner completeness while apply is refused; or owners use this rule to hide a failing root check by labeling every refusal lawful.
minimum_decision_record.adoption_and_compatibility: Pilot only. No G1 field, harness edit, or catalog/lane/template change is requested here. A later content-owner task could bind prove_active_resolution to owner-apply polarity and keep scan-adoption diagnostic. Rollback is to drop that scoring rule. No pre-v1 compatibility claim. distribution_status=not_distributed; adoption_status=not_adopted.
minimum_decision_record.review_trigger: 2026-09-30, or the first other positive owner group's G1 run that would pass prove_active_resolution from scanner completeness while init --apply is a structured refusal, or the first missing-target init that still exits 0 with plan JSON.
minimum_decision_record.retirement_signal: Engineering-core G1 journey definitions already separate scanner diagnostics from active-resolution polarity, missing-target init fail-closes, and this candidate is redundant.

rollback_drill.note: Prior stable shared selection is no shared content change. Participant rollback is a no-op that keeps this record and the 4954 historical files.

content_owner_decision.reason: Digest-bound replica evidence (g1-run.json sha256 0f06c6cf...: prove_active_resolution passed from scan-adoption completeness=complete while the same run's init --apply exited 2 with applied=false and doctor reported the repo blocked) exposes a real engineering-core G1 journey-semantics gap, not just a SoftwareCo preference. The cycle stays a bounded single-group pilot (promotion structurally unavailable), but engineering-core acknowledges the gap and opens its own follow-up task to bind prove_active_resolution to owner-apply polarity (diagnostic scanner completeness alone can never pass it) on the candidate line, per G1-G4 sequencing.
